column1: # *** THE MARRIAGE ACT OF ZELMIRA CARLOTA LERENA, READ IN FULL. 9 October 2026. ***
# *** La Union, Montevideo - Religious Marriage Records 1902-1934 ***, image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-TWWY-Y,
# found by FamilySearch FULL-TEXT search on the phrase "Zelmira Carlota". Headed, in the register's
# own hand, *** "Matrimonio de Cordero y Lorena". ***
# *** THIS IS WHAT THE DISPENSATION LEDGER COULD NOT GIVE. *** Yesterday's nine entries named a
# couple and an impediment and no parent. The ACT names four parents, two ages, two nationalities,
# a profession, an address and a church.

column2: El dia *** 28 de Febrero de 1904 *** en la Iglesia de *** Nuestra Senora de Lourdes *** - the Bishop Titular of Anamaris and Auxiliary of Montevideo, *** RICARDO JARA ***, officiating on the declaration of the Cura Parroco of *** la Metropolitana ***
column3: *** THIS ARCHIVE HAS THE YEAR AS 1901 AND THE ACT SAYS 1904. *** Same day, same month, three years apart. *** THE BOOK DECIDES IT: *** this register runs *** 1902-1934 ***, so a 1901 marriage cannot be in it, and the entry immediately above is dated *** May 1902 ***. The act is primary and the register is sequential. *** AND IT MAKES SENSE OF THE DISPENSATION: *** the Vicar General dispensed the impediment on *** 1 February 1901 *** - they were cleared to marry three years before they did.

column2: *** D. ADOLFO MAXIMO CORDERO ***, soltero, *** ARGENTINO ***, *** medico de profesion ***, *** de veinte y ocho anos de edad ***, domiciliado en la Ciudad de *** SAN JOSE ***, e hijo legitimo de *** D. ADOLFO M. CORDERO y Dona CASIMIRA CHAVARRIA ***
column3: *** A NAME, A NATION, A TRADE AND TWO PARENTS, none of which this archive had. *** An Argentine doctor of twenty-eight living at San Jose - and his father stood as a witness at his own son's wedding.

column2: *** Dona ZELMIRA CARLOTA LERENA ***, soltera, *** oriental ***, *** de veinte anos de edad ***, domiciliada en esta Ciudad *** (Calle Cerro Largo 230) ***, e hija legitima de *** D. ALBERTO [S]ERENA y Dona MARIA INES LARRIERA ***
column3: *** HER PARENTS ARE NOW ON A PRIMARY RECORD. *** This archive has carried Alberto Lerena and Maria Ines Larriera as her parents since 14 September *** from an index ***; here they are in an act. *** AND HER AGE DOES NOT FIT. *** Twenty in February 1904 puts her birth about 1883-84; this register has her born *** 4 November 1880 ***, which would make her twenty-three. *** Both are recorded and neither is preferred. ***

column1: *** THE SURNAME, WRITTEN TWO WAYS IN ONE DOCUMENT ***
column2: Her father is written *** "D. Alberto SERENA" *** and her mother, as a witness four lines later, *** "Dona Maria Ines Larriera de LERENA" ***
column3: *** THE S-FOR-L TRAP, INSIDE A SINGLE ACT. *** This archive has documented seven instances of this surname being read or written with an S - SERENA, LORENA, LESINA. *** Here the same clerk, or the same transcriber, does both in one entry *** - which is the cleanest demonstration of the trap it has yet collected, because no other explanation is available: the two people are husband and wife.

column1: *** THE IMPEDIMENT, AND WHO LIFTED IT ***
column2: habiendoles sido dispensado por el Exmo Senor Arzobispo *** Don Mariano Soler *** el impedimento canonico de *** tercer grado de consanguinidad con atingencia al segundo por linea lateral desigual ***
column3: *** THE ACT CONFIRMS THE LEDGER WORD FOR WORD ***, which is the control on yesterday's reading of the dispensation register. *** AND IT MEANS THE CORDEROS AND THE LERENAS SHARE AN ANCESTOR *** within two or three generations, by two separate paths. The groom's mother is *** CASIMIRA CHAVARRIA ***; the link runs through her or through his father.

column2: Fueron testigos del acto *** D. Adolfo M. Cordero y Dona Maria Ines Larriera de Lerena ***
column3: *** EACH SIDE'S SURVIVING PARENT STOOD FOR THEIR OWN CHILD *** - his father and her mother. Zelmira's father Alberto was alive until 1921, so his absence is not death; he simply did not witness.
